## What's Changed

* **Cycle actions menu fixed:** The three-dot menu on each cycle in the cycles list now opens, and offers edit, start, complete and delete. Older cycles have working actions too. Deleting a cycle asks for confirmation.
* **Cycle and project pages match the issues view:** Cycle and project detail pages now offer the same grouping, filters, list/board switcher, bulk actions and load-more as the team issues page. Issues open on the full issue page in both, instead of a side sheet on projects. Projects keep their Gantt view.
* **Easier issue management in cycles and projects:** *Add issues* opens a searchable picker that finds any issue in the team, not just the first 50. You can select several issues at once and retry any that fail. *New issue* is prefilled with the current cycle or project. *Remove from cycle/project* takes an issue out of the cycle or project without deleting it.
* **Clearer permissions and states:** Guests no longer see create, edit or delete actions on cycles and projects. Project deletion asks for confirmation, and the cycle can be edited from its detail page. Loading and error states and mobile layouts are improved, and cycle statuses and dates are fully translated.
* **Accurate project progress:** The progress number on project lists now matches the progress bar.

### Upgrade Notes

Update your application images. This release adds no database migrations, configuration changes or backend API changes.

**Pull request:** https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/pull/71

### Validation

The candidate `d94f0d5` (PR #71 with `main` merged) passed all 42 checks: [Tests](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39689978473), [Security Scan](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39689978317), [Release Readiness](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39689978501) and [Build & Push](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39689978446). Locally, all 109 browser tests passed, including 12 new tests for cycle and project flows, along with the type check, unit tests and backend tests.

Merge commit `6e21473` contains the same changes, plus only the v0.1.22 version bump from `main`.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/compare/v0.1.22...v0.1.23

## What's Changed

* **Issue version history:** Review recorded title and description edits from either issue view. Browse changes chronologically, see the editor and timestamp, and compare the complete before/after values in your selected app language. Descriptions include sanitized previews and an HTML source view.
* **Reliable history capture:** Content changes and their history now commit together. Failed saves leave no content-history entry, unchanged saves add no revision, and concurrent edits record the actual prior values. Property and automation updates preserve newer content. Private-team access rules continue to apply.
* **Security fixes:** Updated the Go toolchain and all Go image builders to 1.26.10, markdown-it to 14.3.3, and the application and marketing site's Vite dependencies to patched versions. The marketing site's cookie dependency, Caddy's compression library, and the IDE's bundled redirect library are also patched.

### Upgrade Notes

This release includes database migration 47. Back up the database and deploy the new backend together with its migration; do not keep older backend instances writing while the new history trigger is active. Existing recorded changes remain available, but unrecorded historical versions cannot be reconstructed. History from writes without an identified editor shows an unknown author. Version restoration is not included.

Update application images and rebuild/recreate updater and Dev Machine containers so they use the patched Go binaries. Source installations require Go 1.26.10 or newer. Rolling back migration 47 removes automatic capture while preserving history, including nullable author IDs.

**Pull request:** https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/pull/70

### Validation

The reviewed candidate `5430a38195dee7134ce2ac707278aae9a41f81db` passed all 42 checks: [Tests](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39685909433), [Security Scan](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39685909398), [Release Readiness](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39685909431), and [Build & Push](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39685909379). This includes 97 browser tests and native amd64/arm64 runtime and image-security checks. Merge commit `2d5ce8731ef329e292bc92a6bf1a2d7aa0231d3b` has the identical source tree.

This is a prepared draft. Publishing invokes the existing workflow, which updates version files on main; validate the resulting revision before rollout.

The merge commit also passed all 17 checks in [Tests](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39687395019) and [Security Scan](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/actions/runs/39687394997). The attached validation record identifies the reviewed and merged revisions.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/compare/v0.1.20...v0.1.22

## What's Changed

* **Security fixes:** Updated all Go build stages and Dev Machine agent toolchains to Go 1.26.9, addressing the HTTP, HTTP/2, TLS, and reverse-proxy vulnerabilities reported by the security workflow.
* **Patched networking dependencies:** Updated `golang.org/x/net` to 0.60.0 and its required companion modules in the backend and rebuilt Caddy with the same patched dependencies.
* **Broader security checks:** Security scans now run on every push to `main` and include the self-hosted updater image.

### Upgrade Notes

Update your application images. For source-based self-hosting, pull this release, rebuild the updater and Dev Machine images, and recreate affected containers so they use the patched binaries. Source installations require Go 1.26.9 or newer. This release adds no database migrations.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/compare/v0.1.19...v0.1.20

## What's Changed

* **Private teams:** Added privacy controls and membership-based access across issues, projects, cycles, comments, attachments, and real-time updates. Access is revoked when membership is removed; workspace owners and admins retain access. By @carbogninalberto in https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/pull/67
* **More reliable navigation:** Temporary membership-check failures no longer redirect users or leave them stuck on the splash screen. Older failed requests also no longer override a successful retry. By @carbogninalberto in https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/pull/68
* **Safer self-hosted upgrades:** The updater stops backend writers before privacy migrations and keeps the backend stopped if a migration fails, preventing an older version from running against a partially migrated database.
* **Fixed Docker routing:** API requests, uploads, and health/readiness endpoints now reach the backend correctly instead of being intercepted by the frontend fallback.
* **Configurable build memory:** Docker UI builds now default to a configurable 4 GB Node heap.
* **Dependency fixes:** Updated `source-map-js` to address a denial-of-service flaw, refreshed vulnerable marketing-site build dependencies, and patched a code-server compression memory leak in the Dev Machines IDE image.
* **Updated self-hosting documentation:** Added private-team setup, legacy attachment handling, migration requirements, and downgrade guidance.

### Upgrade Notes

Existing teams remain public after upgrading. Enabling private teams introduces persistent workspace-wide restrictions: saved views, filtered/view-based public links, workspace export, AI expansion, outgoing webhooks, Dev Machines, and live presence are disabled—even if all teams are later made public or deleted.

Back up PostgreSQL and asset storage before upgrading. Apply migrations with backend writers stopped, and deploy the new backend and migrations together. See the [private-team documentation](https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle#private-teams) before enabling privacy.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/carbogninalberto/kuayle/compare/v0.1.18...v0.1.19
